name: Molmo-7B-D-0924
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, notable for the 2D POOLING innovation. (1) Vision: OpenAI CLIP-style ViT-L/14. The published config.json OMITS the vision_backbone block entirely; these dims come from the VisionBackboneConfig dataclass defaults in modeling_molmo.py shipped in the same repo: image_default_input_size 336x336, image_patch_size 14, image_emb_dim 1024, image_num_heads 16, image_head_dim 64, image_mlp_dim 4096, gelu. So a 336x336 crop = (336/14)^2 = 576 ViT patches. THE INNOVATION: image_pooling_h 2, image_pooling_w 2, image_pooling_2d 'attention'. Molmo does not pixel-shuffle or average-pool -- it runs a learned MultiHeadDotProductAttention over each 2x2 spatial neighbourhood (MultiHeadAttentionPool, with 'attention_2wide' and 'attention_v2' variants also implemented). The projector is a 2-layer MLP (image_projector 'mlp'). Result: 576 patches -> 144 LLM tokens per crop, a 4x reduction that is content-adaptive rather than a fixed reshape. (2) LLM: OLMo-style dense decoder, 28 layers, hidden 3584, 28 heads / 4 KV, head_dim 128, intermediate 37888, qkv_bias true, max_position 4096, rope_theta 1e6, vocab 152,064. ARCHITECTURE = dense. DOMINANCE: the efficient default is a single 336x336 crop = 144 vision tokens, which is TINY -- text dominates prefill for the default single-crop path (unlike every other VLM in this slice). Molmo also supports multi-crop, where dominance flips to vision. KV CACHE: 28 * 4 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 57,344 B/token. max_position_embeddings is only 4096, so resident KV caps at 224 MiB/sequence -- Molmo is a short-context model by design. params_b 8.021 = HF API safetensors total (8,021,025,280).
